description: This file defines the DataGroupHelper class in the OrangeHRM installer utility. It provides methods for reading, inserting, and managing permissions related to data groups, APIs, screens, and user roles within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class interacts with a database via Doctrine DBAL, and handles YAML configuration files to set permissions.

classes.name: DataGroupHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing data groups, API permissions, screen permissions, and related user role permissions within OrangeHRM. Facilitates reading permission configurations from YAML files and inserting corresponding records into the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes DataGroupHelper with a Doctrine DBAL Connection.

methods.name: readApiPermissions
methods.description: Reads API permissions from a YAML file and creates Api DTO objects.

methods.name: readDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Reads data group permissions from a YAML file and creates DataGroup DTO objects.

methods.name: readScreenPermissions
methods.description: Reads screen permissions from a YAML file and creates Screen DTO objects.

methods.name: insertApiPermissions
methods.description: Inserts API permissions from a YAML file into the database, establishing API, module, and data group associations, and assigning user role permissions.

methods.name: insertDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Inserts data group permissions from a YAML file into the database and assigns user role permissions.

methods.name: insertScreenPermissions
methods.description: Inserts screen permissions from a YAML file into the database, including screen details and user role permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a data group by its name.

methods.name: getScreenIdByModuleAndUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a screen based on its module ID and URL.

methods.name: getModuleIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a module by its name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: getUserRoleIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a user role by its name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: addDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for a user role on a specific data group in the database.
